sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajnesh Oswal, Judge
 Order
1. The dispute in the present appeal is with regard to the locus of the claimants/respondent Nos. 1 to 3 to file the claim petition.

2. Order dated 16.01.2017 is the subject matter of the present appeal, whereby a sum of Rs. 50,000/-
was awarded as interim compensation to the claimants/respondent Nos. 1 to 3.
3.
The operation of order dated 16.01.2017 has been stayed in this appeal vide order dated 02.05.2017.
4. The matter has been pending for the last more than six years and till date the main petition filed by the claimants/respondent Nos. 1 to 3 has not been decided.
5. Six years is too long a period for disposal of any petition particularly under Motor Vehicles Act.

6. In view of the controversy involved in the present appeal with regard to locus of the claimants/respondent No. 1 to 3 to file the said petition and more particularly taking into consideration that the order impugned has remained stayed for six long years, this Court deems it appropriate to direct the learned tribunal to decide the claim petition as expeditiously as possible.

7. Accordingly, the present appeal is disposed of with a direction to the learned Tribunal to dispose of the claim petition with a period of six months from the date copy of this order is furnished to the Tribunal.
